$note: Agent-facing contract for the Rem Design System. One read gives every component's props, variants, usage rules, and platform mirror. GENERATED — do not edit. Sources: agent/props.json + components/*.md front-matter + tokens/tokens.json.

rules.do: Set the type role with `variant`; it maps 1:1 to a DesignTokens.Typography role.
rules.dont: Apply a raw font size/weight to Text or wrap it to restyle.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: Text variant must be one of the 12 roles (web); ds_no_raw_font_size (Swift)

rules.do: Pick a label role with `color` (primary/secondary/tertiary) or brand/brandOnFill.
rules.dont: Pass a raw hex/CSS color to Text.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: Text color must be primary|secondary|tertiary|brand|brandOnFill

rules.do: Use `color="brandOnFill"` for brand-tinted text sitting on a gray fill (it clears AA in dark mode).
rules.dont: Use plain `brand` on a gray pill — it fails contrast in dark mode.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only

Surface.mirrors: The card/panel shell used across Rem surfaces

rules.do: Use one of the three materials by meaning: solid = a thing you act on, inset = quiet tool output, glass = floating/translucent status.
rules.dont: Invent a new fill treatment or mix material semantics.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: Surface material must be solid|inset|glass

rules.do: Use the `radius` / `padding` tokens (default `medium` / `md`).
rules.dont: Hardcode a corner radius or padding value.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: Surface radius/padding must be a token; ds_no_hardcoded_corner_radius / ds_no_magic_padding (Swift)

Card.mirrors: A Surface preset (secondary background, medium radius, hairline border)

rules.do: Use Card as the standard container for grouped content; set `padding="none"` and nest ListRows for a grouped list.
rules.dont: Rebuild a bordered secondary panel by hand, or nest a Card in a Card.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only

rules.do: Keep the material vocabulary (solid/inset/glass) and token radius (default medium).
rules.dont: Invent a fill or hardcode a radius.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: Card material/radius/padding/background must be tokens

Pill.mirrors: SharedPillView / the single badge in the system

rules.do: Use Pill for every badge — status and category alike.
rules.dont: Hand-roll badge markup or introduce a second badge component.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (system rule from README)

rules.do: Tint status with `tone` (neutral/blue/green/red/orange).
rules.dont: Pass a raw color; use the tone that carries the meaning.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: Pill tone must be neutral|blue|green|red|orange

rules.do: Add a leading `dot` (e.g. a calendar color) or `icon` for category badges.
rules.dont: Encode category by inventing new tones.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only

ListRow.mirrors: SharedDeviceRow / SharedGatewayRow / SharedSkillRow (the settings/list row pattern)

rules.do: Use ListRow for settings/list rows: leading icon, title + subtitle, trailing accessory.
rules.dont: Hand-build a row from an HStack/flex with ad-hoc spacing.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only

rules.do: Group rows in a `Card padding="none"`; hide the last row's separator.
rules.dont: Stack bare rows with manual dividers.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only

ContainedIcon.mirrors: The settings-row icon (rounded colored container + white glyph)

rules.do: Set the container `color` from a token var (brand blue by default, or a system color).
rules.dont: Pass a raw hex color to the container.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (color is a free string; keep it a token var by convention)

rules.do: Use the default 28px in rows; 44px for a larger emphasis icon.
rules.dont: Sprinkle arbitrary sizes.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only

rules.do: Use the design-system Button for every tappable action.
rules.dont: Drop a raw <button> (web) or bare Button {} styling (SwiftUI) into a screen.
rules.enforced_by: react/forbid-elements (button) + no-restricted-syntax in _adherence.oxlintrc.json

rules.do: Use exactly one `primary` button as the main action of a screen or sheet.
rules.dont: Place two `primary` buttons in the same row or context — the user can't tell which is the main action.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (candidate for a new adherence rule)

rules.do: Express destructive actions with role="destructive" on settingsCTA/recovery.
rules.dont: Hand-tint a button red to mean 'dangerous'.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: Button role must be 'primary' | 'destructive'

rules.do: Pick the variant that matches the action's job (primary / settingsCTA / recovery / connect).
rules.dont: Invent a new visual treatment or override the button's classes for a one-off look.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: Button variant must be 'primary' | 'settingsCTA' | 'recovery' | 'connect'

MessageBubble.mirrors: Rem chat message (user bubble / assistant prose)

rules.do: Set `role` — `user` renders a right-aligned brand-blue bubble; `assistant` renders left-aligned plain prose (no bubble).
rules.dont: Wrap assistant text in a bubble, or right-align it.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: MessageBubble role must be user|assistant

rules.do: Inject affordances through the slots (`leading`, `trailing`, `send`, `attachments`); the bar is presentation-only.
rules.dont: Fork the composer to hardcode a specific button set.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: ComposerBar accepts only its declared props

ContextualMessage.mirrors: RemContextualMessage (persistent in-context status card, glass material)

rules.do: Use ContextualMessage for a persistent, in-context state (connection problem, empty/loading, inline notice).
rules.dont: Use it for a brief confirmation — that's a Toast.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only

rules.do: Set `tone` (info/success/warning/error/neutral) — it picks the glyph and accent.
rules.dont: Hand-pick a glyph/color that contradicts the tone.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: ContextualMessage tone must be info|success|warning|error|neutral

rules.do: Keep it quiet and collapsed by default; use `live` for the still-thinking shimmer.
rules.dont: Force reasoning open by default or style it as primary content.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only

rules.do: Use it purely as the transient 'assistant is typing' indicator, typically inside a bubble/surface.
rules.dont: Use it as a general-purpose loading spinner elsewhere.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only

rules.do: Use Toast for a brief, non-blocking confirmation or notice ('Reconnected', 'Task added').
rules.dont: Put actions/buttons in a Toast, or use it for a persistent state (use ContextualMessage).
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: Toast accepts variant + message only

rules.do: Set `variant` (info/success/warning/error) — it sets the glyph and tint.
rules.dont: Hand-tint the capsule.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: Toast variant must be info|success|warning|error

ToolResultCard.mirrors: ToolResultCardView (wrapper for a tool-call result; inset material)

rules.do: Use ToolResultCard (inset material) to wrap any tool-call result in a conversation: icon + title header, result rows in the body.
rules.dont: Render tool output as a solid Card or as loose text in the thread.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (material vocabulary: inset = quiet tool output)

rules.do: Make long results `collapsible` and default them collapsed.
rules.dont: Dump a long result fully expanded into the thread.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: ToolResultCard accepts only its declared props

rules.do: Use TaskEventRow for both tasks and calendar events in the agenda; `time` fills the fixed 64px leading slot, `done` renders the task status circle.
rules.dont: Build separate bespoke rows for tasks vs events.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: TaskEventRow accepts only its declared props

rules.do: Express calendar / list / duration / overdue through the provided props.
rules.dont: Hand-roll Pills inside the row for those badges.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only

rules.do: For a receded (done/blocked/stale) row, apply the deemphasized opacity ONCE.
rules.dont: Stack dimming (two applications multiply to ~0.30 and read as broken).
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (DesignTokens.Opacity.deemphasized)

SuggestedTaskRow.mirrors: SuggestedTaskRow (a proposed task in the Agenda)

rules.do: Always give the `subtitle` — the attribution / WHY line (what the suggestion is based on).
rules.dont: Show a bare suggested title with no reason.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (product: proposals must explain themselves)

rules.do: Keep the dashed-ring 'not yet real' treatment; offer accept (`onAccept`) and dismiss (`onDismiss`).
rules.dont: Style a suggestion like a committed TaskEventRow.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: SuggestedTaskRow action must be add|move

ProposalCard.mirrors: RemProposalCardView (a task-update proposal in a conversation)

rules.do: Pending shows the change + Approve/Dismiss; resolved states (succeeded/failed/dismissed/stale) show a terminal, non-actionable summary.
rules.dont: Leave Approve/Dismiss live on a resolved proposal.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: ProposalCard state must be pending|succeeded|failed|dismissed|stale

rules.do: Use `stale` to mean the proposal is no longer relevant — a quiet terminal state, not an error.
rules.dont: Delete/hide it or render `stale` like `failed`.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (product: stale = stop-nagging, not delete)

rules.do: Show the relative `label` (Today/Tomorrow/weekday) over the full `date`; hide the Today jump when `isToday`.
rules.dont: Show only a raw date with no relative label, or keep a redundant Today jump on today.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: DateNavigationHeader accepts only its declared props

rules.do: Use CalendarEventsCard to render a calendar tool result — it's the ToolResultCard preset for events (inset material).
rules.dont: Hand-build an events list in a solid Card, or bypass the ToolResultCard header.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: CalendarEventsCard accepts events, calendarName, collapsible, defaultExpanded

rules.do: Use RemindersCard to render a reminders tool result — the ToolResultCard preset for reminders (inset material).
rules.dont: Hand-build a reminders list in a solid Card, or bypass the ToolResultCard header.
rules.enforced_by: no-restricted-syntax: RemindersCard accepts reminders, collapsible, defaultExpanded

rules.do: Start a new Agenda-like screen from this template and swap in real data; keep the composition (day header → rows → suggestion).
rules.dont: Re-lay-out the agenda from scratch or reorder its regions arbitrarily.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (screen template — the on-rails starting point)

rules.do: Start a tasks-list screen from this template: large title over grouped task rows and a suggestion.
rules.dont: Rebuild the list layout or invent a different grouping affordance.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (screen template)

rules.do: Group settings into `Card padding="none"` blocks of `ListRow`s with `ContainedIcon` leadings; put destructive actions in a `Button` with role="destructive".
rules.dont: Lay out settings as ad-hoc stacks or hand-styled rows.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (screen template)

rules.do: Keep the structure: nav bar → scrolling thread (turns, tool results, reasoning, typing) → ComposerBar pinned at the bottom.
rules.dont: Float the composer, or rebuild the thread with bespoke bubbles.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (screen template)

rules.do: Use this as the canonical conversation composition: user + assistant turns, a reasoning disclosure, a tool-result card, an inline proposal, and the composer.
rules.dont: Improvise a different arrangement of chat elements.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (screen template)

OnboardingSequencer.mirrors: OnboardingFlow.swift (signIn → dataSharingConsent → …) — the native first-run sequencer

steps.desc: Ordered step slots: Sign-in → Consent → (#12 middle steps); no deploy slot

signInState.desc: Sign-in step state, mapped from the host's real auth

onComplete.desc: Fires when the last step advances

rules.do: Compose the path from the ordered step slots you pass (Sign-in → Consent → the middle steps).
rules.dont: Reintroduce a deploy/provisioning step anywhere in the sequence — the runtime migration removes it.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (the sequencer injects no steps of its own; the path is exactly its `steps`)

rules.do: Keep the sign-in and consent copy + Sign-in-with-Apple treatment exactly as the authoritative reference (`tasks/refs/onboarding/01-sign-in.png`, `02-consent.png`).
rules.dont: Reword consent copy, restyle the Apple button, or invent a visual treatment for the reproduced steps.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (Reproduce mode — fidelity is verified against the reference frame)

rules.do: Drive sign-in from the host's real auth by mapping it to `SignInState` (returning / new / checking / error / recovery); advance only on success.
rules.dont: Fake-advance from the button or hard-code a signed-in state in the component.
rules.enforced_by: prose-only (the step is state-driven; the host owns auth + advancement)

rules.do: Bind every visual to the generated tokens (RemTokens / DesignTokens) and reuse the canonical ContainedIcon for hero + row leadings. The CTA button and the consent legal rows are hand-rolled natively (no Compose Button / ListRow primitive exists yet) — keep them token-bound too.
rules.dont: Introduce call-site literals, or claim canonical Button / ListRow reuse the Compose surface does not perform.
rules.enforced_by: SwiftLint ds_* rules (Swift) + oxlint no-raw-hex (web); prose for Compose until a lint lands
